fee_notes: Single store fee is $30,000. Area Development Agreement requires minimum 3 stores; Development Fee is 100% of IFF for first store plus 50% of IFF for each additional store (e.g., $60,000 for 3 stores). PB3 Machine must also be purchased from Sambazon Inc. at ~$14,430.
raw_excerpt: If you purchase a franchise to operate a single SAMBAZON Store, you must pay to us an Initial Franchise Fee of $30,000.
